rules.action: Moves through interactive content inside the current article and on to the next article's content in reading order; articles are focusable but never tab stops (Card `focusable` renders `tabindex="-1"`, so a hundred cards are not a hundred stops), and focus reaches one by pointer, by Ctrl+Home/End returning, or through a screen reader's browse mode — the feed commands below act from there.
Moves focus to the next article (the APG feed command).
Moves focus to the previous article.

Moves focus to the first focusable element after the feed in the document; with `hasMore`, instead triggers a load, or does nothing while `loading` (press again once it has loaded and `hasMore` is false). Feed commands act only from inside an article, not from the new-items button. The key is always consumed there, the `loading` case included, so a feed command never falls through to the browser's scroll to the end of the document.
Moves focus to the new-items button when shown, else to the last focusable element before the feed in the document.
